description: Trust-boundary inventory (M0-E01-S01 draft). Architecture: browser -> unprivileged Go API -> durable operation manager -> restrictive local Unix-socket host agent -> libvirt/QEMU/KVM; PaaS runtime only inside a separate workload VM (ADR-004, ADR-011). Security properties are enumerated in each boundary's `security` object and pinned by tools/check_interfaces.py; prose fields are explanatory only.

browser-api.transport: HTTPS to the API; scaffold listens on http://127.0.0.1:8081 (loopback only)
browser-api.authentication: Opaque server-side session in an HttpOnly, SameSite=Strict cookie (Secure over HTTPS) for the single local administrator; Argon2id password hash; idle and absolute expiry; server-side revocation on sign-out; CSRF token (X-CSRF-Token, derived from the session) on cookie-authenticated state-changing requests and a pre-sign-in token for sign-in; failure throttling. Design: DR-015 D2.
browser-api.authorization: API enforces server-side RBAC per resource and action, deny by default, resource ownership check on every request (no IDOR).
browser-api.audit: API records actor, action, resource id, outcome and correlation id; secret-bearing fields redacted (redaction rules in prohibited.json).

api-operation-manager.transport: In-process Go interface; no network listener
api-operation-manager.authentication: Not applicable in-process; authenticated actor identity is propagated with every call.
api-operation-manager.authorization: API authorizes before submission; the manager re-checks resource ownership and rejects operations on resources outside the actor's project.
api-operation-manager.audit: Operation lifecycle events (submitted, started, succeeded, failed, cancelled) with actor and operation id.

operation-manager-host-agent.transport: Local Unix domain socket only; no TCP listener (public or loopback)
operation-manager-host-agent.authentication: SO_PEERCRED peer UID/GID allowlist on the socket.
operation-manager-host-agent.authorization: Agent accepts only enumerated typed commands with validated arguments; no general command execution, no sudo wrapper.
operation-manager-host-agent.audit: Agent logs command type, operation id and outcome; argument values that may contain secrets are redacted.

host-agent-libvirt.transport: libvirt API via the local qemu:///system socket (the privilege boundary)
host-agent-libvirt.authentication: libvirt socket permissions granted only to the agent's dedicated service account.
host-agent-libvirt.authorization: Agent builds domain/network/volume definitions from typed parameters; never forwards client-supplied XML; storage paths confined to managed pools.
host-agent-libvirt.audit: Agent records libvirt call class, target resource id and result.

paas-controller-workload-vm.transport: Managed network to a separately created PaaS workload VM; Podman runs only inside that VM (ADR-004)
paas-controller-workload-vm.authentication: Per-VM credential provisioned at creation; never shared with the hypervisor host.
paas-controller-workload-vm.authorization: Controller may only deploy container images to its own managed workload VM; no host-level container execution.
paas-controller-workload-vm.audit: Deployment events with app id, image digest and outcome.

auth_gate: While auth_design_approved is false, every category except 'health' is rejected (PRIVILEGED_BEFORE_AUTH), including reads, to avoid pre-auth IDOR. Stricter than draft AC02's wording; noted for the sponsor.
